title: Employees
description: Everyone on the school's staff, active and inactive.

list.label: Employees
list.emptyBody: Add the first employee to start building the staff list.
list.noResultsBody: Try another search, or clear the filters to see everyone.

placeholders.address: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

hints.phone: Mobile, landline or international. Digits, spaces, +, - and brackets.
hints.basicSalary: Net: what the employee receives each month, in Egyptian pounds. The school pays income tax and the employee's insurance share on top.
hints.contract: Defaults to 1 June – 31 May. Changing the start moves the end to one year later.
hints.usesBus: Turn on if the employee rides the school bus.
hints.hiddenItem: Hidden from new choices; kept for this employee.
hints.insuredSalary: The monthly wage social insurance is worked out on, in Egyptian pounds. It doesn't change the net salary.
hints.insuranceStatus: Choosing “Not insured” clears the insurance number, date and salary.
hints.managerNotManaging: No longer in a managing role; kept for this employee.
hints.noManagers: No one can be chosen yet. Turn on “Manages people” for a job title in Settings → HR lists.
hints.probationEnd: Filled from the hire date; change it if this employee’s probation differs.
hints.otherStages: Other stages this person works in. Each stage's head sees them; penalties go to the head of the stage where they happened.

noDepartments: No departments yet. Add them in Settings.
noStages: No stages yet. Add them in Settings.
noJobTitles: No job titles yet. Add them in Settings.

errors.nationalId: The national ID must be exactly 14 digits.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number of 7 to 20 characters, like 01012345678 or +20 2 2345 6789.
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.hireDateFuture: The hire date can't be in the future.
errors.salaryPositive: The salary must be more than 0.
errors.contractOrder: The contract end must be after its start.
errors.insuranceNumber: The insurance number must be digits only (up to 20).
errors.registrationDateFuture: The registration date can't be in the future.
errors.insuredSalaryPositive: The insured salary must be more than 0.
errors.iban: Enter an Egyptian IBAN: EG followed by 27 digits.
errors.graduationYear: Choose a year from 1950 to this year.
errors.probationBeforeHire: The probation end can’t be before the hire date.
errors.otherStageIsMain: The main stage is already this person's stage. Pick other stages here.

create.title: Add employee
create.description: The employee code is assigned automatically when you save.

status.deactivateBody: Their record and history are kept. They won't be included in new payroll runs and can't get new penalties or lateness entries.
status.reactivateBody: They will be included in new payroll runs again and can get penalties and lateness entries.

photo.description: Shown on the employee’s card and profile. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to {max} MB. Cropped to a square.
photo.current: This is the photo in use.
photo.none: No photo yet. A male or female silhouette is shown until you add one.
photo.ready: Preview of {name}. Upload it to use it.
photo.readyOnSave: Preview of {name}. It is added when you save the employee.

problems.type: Only PNG, JPG or WebP files can be used.
problems.size: The file must be {max} MB or smaller.
